title: The bus stop roof leaks, again
text: Marta waits here at 5 a.m. after every night shift. “It's not a bus stop, it's a shower with a timetable.”

options.label: Patch it with a tarp and cable ties

effects.label: Bus stop roof – patched by you

options.says: Marta: “Dry! I'm going to stand here for fun now.”
options.headline: Bus stop dry for the first time since 2019

options.label: Report it to the town hall
options.says: Town hall: “Your concern is important to us.” The roof keeps leaking, importantly.

title: Someone dumped a sofa by the bottle bank
text: Hassan: “It's been there so long people sit on it to wait for the bus. The bus doesn't stop there.”

options.label: Haul it away yourself
options.says: Hassan: “You carried a sofa alone. I have never respected anyone more.”
options.headline: Mystery sofa finally leaves the bottle bank

options.label: Tip off the scrap dealer about the metal frame
options.says: The scrap dealer takes the frame and pays you a €10 finder's fee. The cushions stay, judging you.

options.label: Post a photo in the town's online group
options.says: 143 angry emojis. Nobody moves the sofa, but everyone feels heard.

title: The light on Main Street is out
text: Dieter: “Third week. I walked into the post box. The post box was fine.”

options.label: Report it to the town hall
options.says: Dieter files your report in the folder, under ‘Hope’.

options.label: Buy Dieter a head torch
options.says: Dieter now looks like a very small miner. He loves it.

options.label: Fix the wiring yourself

effects.label: Main Street light – fixed by you

options.says: Dieter: “Light! I can see the pothole again. Marvellous.”
options.headline: Main Street light back on; post box relieved

title: The swing chain snapped
text: Leni: “I was nearly at the moon.”

options.label: Buy a new chain and fit it
options.says: Leni: “Higher! No, higher! No, that's too high. Higher!”
options.headline: Swing fixed; local girl ‘nearly reaches moon’

options.label: Bake for a cake sale with Tomasz

effects.label: Swing fixed by the cake sale

options.says: Tomasz sells your lopsided muffins as ‘rustic’. The swing is fixed by teatime.
options.headline: Cake sale saves the swing

options.label: Push Leni on the other swing instead
options.says: Leni: “This one's slower. But you do good sound effects.”

title: The school toilets are flooding
text: Mehmet: “The drain is blocked with, I think, a whole sandwich. Maybe a lunch box. Maybe a child's hopes.”

options.label: Clear the drain properly
options.says: Mehmet: “22 years and nobody has fixed it first try. You're hired. Unofficially.”

options.label: Buy the school a drain snake
options.says: Mehmet names the drain snake Kevin and uses it daily.

options.label: Lend Mehmet your mop
options.says: Mehmet: “A mop. Of course. Why didn't I think of—” He has four mops.

title: Potholes on the bridge road
text: Amira: “I've named them. That big one is Gerhard.”

options.label: Cold-patch them with Rolf's shovel
options.says: Amira honks twice as she drives over the smooth bit. That's bus for ‘thank you’.

options.label: Paint bright warning circles round them
options.says: Now the potholes are dangerous AND festive.

options.label: Start an online petition for a new bridge
options.says: 212 signatures. Dieter signed four times, once as Benno.

title: The students upstairs are partying. On a Tuesday. Again.
text: Marta, through the wall: “Leni has a spelling test tomorrow. I have a night shift. The bass has neither.”

options.label: Knock and ask them nicely
options.says: They turn it down and give you pizza. Diplomacy!

options.label: Call the Ordnungsamt
options.says: The Ordnungsamt arrives in 90 minutes, exactly as the party ends. Efficient, in its way.

title: Rats behind Café Lindner
text: Tomasz: “One of them looked at my Streuselkuchen like it had a plan.”

options.label: Brick up the gap under the bins
options.says: Tomasz: “Sealed! Fort Lindner stands.”

options.label: Pay for pest control
options.says: The pest controller is gone in an hour. So are the rats. So is your €35.

options.label: Name the rat Kevin and move on
options.says: Tomasz: “Kevin has been seen in the kitchen. Kevin is fired.”

title: Someone painted ‘PFENNIG OUT’ on the town hall
text: Mayor Pfennig: “€20 to whoever removes it. Discreetly.” Dieter notes that the spelling is correct.

options.label: Scrub it off for the €20
options.says: Half the town watches you scrub. Dieter boos, then brings you tea.

options.label: Leave it. It's spelled correctly.
options.says: The town quietly agrees with the wall.

title: Frau Keller's heating is out
text: Frau Keller: “I'm wearing both cardigans. I haven't worn both cardigans since 1987.”

options.label: Fix the boiler (she insists on paying)
options.says: Frau Keller: “Warm! Take the money, and take this cake, and take off your shoes.”

options.label: Lend her your electric heater
options.says: Your flat is freezing. Frau Keller's is lovely. She sends a postcard about it.

options.label: Bring her soup and call the landlord for her
options.says: The landlord promises Thursday. Frau Keller promises to ring him every hour until Thursday.
